title: Video Insights reports
content_data:
# Run a Video Insights report Use this endpoint to run a Video Insights report on videos across one or more ad accounts, encompassing both Spark Ads and non-Spark Ads. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/creative/report/get/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | | report_type {Required} | string | Report type.

Enum values:
  • `VIDEO_INSIGHT`: a Video Insights report for one or more advertiser accounts.
| | advertiser_id {+Conditional} | string | Either `advertiser_id` or `advertiser_ids` has to be set.

The advertiser ID that you want to run reports for. | | advertiser_ids {+Conditional} | string[] | Either `advertiser_id` or `advertiser_ids` has to be set.

A list of advertiser IDs that you want to run reports for.

Max size: 50.

Note:

  • You need to have access to all the corresponding ad accounts. To retrieve the ad accounts in a Business Center that you have access to, use [/bc/asset/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1739432717798401).
  • If the currencies of the ad accounts vary, the currency of the metrics will default to USD.
| | start_date {Required} | string | Query start date, closed interval, in the format of `YYYY-MM-DD` (UTC+0 time).

Example: `2024-01-01`.

The maximum query time range defined by `start_date` and `end_date` is 365 days. | | end_date{Required} | string | Query end date closed interval, in the format of `YYYY-MM-DD` (UTC+0 time).

Example: `2024-01-01`.

The maximum query time range defined by `start_date` and `end_date` is 365 days. | | metrics_fields | string[] | The metrics that you want to retrieve data for.

  • If this field is not passed, all the metrics supported in Video Insights reports will be returned by default.
  • To find the supported metrics, see [Supported metrics in Video Insights reports](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1789703614085122).
| | filtering | object | Filtering conditions. | #| material_id| string[] | A list of video material IDs.

Max size: 20.

To obtain the material ID of a video, use [/file/video/ad/search/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1740050472224769). | #| material_name | string | The video material name.

Fuzzy search is supported. | #| tiktok_item_ids | string[] | An ID list of TikTok Spark Ads posts that the video or videos were used to create.

Max size: 20.

To obtain TikTok post IDs, use [/tt_video/info/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738376324021250) or [/identity/video/get/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740218475032577). | #| country_code | string[] | A code list of locations where the videos were delivered.

For enum values, see [Appendix - Location code](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737585867307010). | #| creative_formats | string[] | List of creative formats.

Enum values:
  • `VIDEO_16_9`: Video (16:9).
  • `VIDEO_1_1`: Video (1:1).
  • `VIDEO_9_16`: Video (9:16).
  • `OTHER`: Other.
| #| video_material_sources | string[] | List of video material sources.

Enum values:
  • `UPLOADED_TO_TIKTOK_ADS_MANAGER`: Uploaded to TikTok Ads Manager.
  • `UPLOADED_TO_CATALOG`: Uploaded to Catalog.
  • `CREATIVE_TOOL_SMART_VIDEO`: Creative Tool - Smart Video.
  • `CREATIVE_TOOL_QUICK_OPTIMIZATION`: Creative Tool - Quick Optimization.
  • `CREATIVE_TOOL_VIDEO_TEMPLATE`: Creative Tool - Video Template.
  • `CREATIVE_TOOL_SMART_VIDEO_SOUNDTRACK`: Creative Tool - Smart Video Soundtrack.
  • `CREATIVE_TOOL_TIKTOK_VIDEO_EDITOR`: Creative Tool - TikTok Video Editor.
  • `TIKTOK_CREATIVE_EXCHANGE`: TikTok Creative Exchange.
  • `CATALOG_VIDEO_TEMPLATE`: Catalog Video Template.
  • `DYNAMIC_VIDEO_EDITOR`: Dynamic Video Editor.
  • `CREATIVE_CHALLENGE`: Creative challenge.
  • `AUTOMATED_CREATIVE_OPTIMIZATION`: Automated Creative Optimization.
  • `OTHER`: Other.
  • `QUICK_GENERATION`: Quick Generation.
  • `CREATIVE_CENTER_VIDEO_UPLOAD`: Creative Center - Video upload.
  • `CREATIVE_CENTER_TIKTOK_VIDEO_EDITOR`：Creative Center - TikTok video editor.
  • `CREATIVE_CENTER_VIDEO_TEMPLATE`：Creative Center - Video template.
  • `DYNAMIC_SCENE`：Dynamic Scene.
  • `SMART_OPTIMIZATION_TOOL`: Smart Optimization Tool.
| #| placement | string[] | List of ad placements for the videos.

Enum values:
  • `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`: TikTok.
  • `PLACEMENT_PANGLE`: Pangle.
  • `PLACEMENT_GLOBAL_APP_BUNDLE`: Global App Bundle.
| #| identities | string[] | Identity types that were used for the delivery of the videos.

Enum values:
  • `SPARK_ADS`: Spark Ads identities, including Authorized User, TikTok User, and TikTok Account User in Business Center identities.
  • `NON_SPARK_ADS`: Non-Spark Ads identities, that is, Custom User identities.

To learn more about identity types, see [Identities](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1738958351620097). | #| ad_name | string | The ad name.

Fuzzy search is supported. | #| ad_id | string[] | A list of ad IDs.

Bulk query is supported.

Max size: 20. | #| adgroup_name | string | The ad group name.

Fuzzy search is supported. | #| adgroup_id | string[] | A list of ad group IDs.

Max size: 20. | #| campaign_name | string | The campaign name.

Fuzzy search is supported. | #| campaign_id | string[] | A list of campaign IDs.

Max size: 20. | | sort_field | string | Field to sort by.

The supported fields are listed in [Supported metrics in Video Insights reports](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1789703614085122). | | sort_type | string | Sorting order.

Enum values: `ASC`, `DESC`.
Default value: `DESC`.| | page | number | Current number of pages.

Default value: 1.
Value range: ≥ 1. | | page_size| number | Page size.

Default value: 10.
Value range: 1-1,000. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/creative/report/get/?report_type=VIDEO_INSIGHT&advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}&start_date=2023-12-24&end_date=2024-01-23' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |-|-|-| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #| list | object[] | Video insights data.

Note: By default, only videos with a total cost (`spend`) greater than 0 will be included. Videos with no cost will be filtered out. | ##| metrics | object | Metric data for the video.

  • If `metrics_fields` is not passed in the request, all the metrics supported in Video Insights reports will be returned by default. To find the supported metrics, see [Supported metrics in Video Insights reports](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1789703614085122).
  • If `metrics_fields` is passed in the request, only the specified metrics supported will be returned.
| ##| info | object | Material information for the video. | ###| material_id | string | Video material ID. | ###| material_name | string | Video material name. | ###| create_time | string | The time at which the video was created, in [ISO-8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

Example: "2024-01-01T00:00:01Z". | ###| tiktok_item_ids | string[] | Returned only when the video (`material_id`) has been used to create Spark Ads.

The ID list of the TikTok Spark Ads posts that are created using the video. | ###| country_code| string[] | The code list of locations that the video (`material_id`) was delivered in.

For enum values, see [Appendix - Location code]( https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737585867307010). | ###| video_material_source | string | Video material source.

Enum values:
  • `UPLOADED_TO_TIKTOK_ADS_MANAGER`: Uploaded to TikTok Ads Manager.
  • `UPLOADED_TO_CATALOG`: Uploaded to Catalog.
  • `CREATIVE_TOOL_SMART_VIDEO`: Creative Tool - Smart Video.
  • `CREATIVE_TOOL_QUICK_OPTIMIZATION`: Creative Tool - Quick Optimization.
  • `CREATIVE_TOOL_VIDEO_TEMPLATE`: Creative Tool - Video Template.
  • `CREATIVE_TOOL_SMART_VIDEO_SOUNDTRACK`: Creative Tool - Smart Video Soundtrack.
  • `CREATIVE_TOOL_TIKTOK_VIDEO_EDITOR`: Creative Tool - TikTok Video Editor.
  • `TIKTOK_CREATIVE_EXCHANGE`: TikTok Creative Exchange.
  • `CATALOG_VIDEO_TEMPLATE`: Catalog Video Template.
  • `DYNAMIC_VIDEO_EDITOR`: Dynamic Video Editor.
  • `CREATIVE_CHALLENGE`: Creative challenge.
  • `AUTOMATED_CREATIVE_OPTIMIZATION`: Automated Creative Optimization.
  • `OTHER`: Other.
  • `QUICK_GENERATION`: Quick Generation.
  • `CREATIVE_CENTER_VIDEO_UPLOAD`: Creative Center - Video upload.
  • `CREATIVE_CENTER_TIKTOK_VIDEO_EDITOR`：Creative Center - TikTok video editor.
  • `CREATIVE_CENTER_VIDEO_TEMPLATE`：Creative Center - Video template.
  • `DYNAMIC_SCENE`：Dynamic Scene.
  • `SMART_OPTIMIZATION_TOOL`: Smart Optimization Tool.

Note: If the material source of the video cannot be identified, the value of this field might be null. | ###| placement | string[] | The ad placements of the video.

Enum values:

  • `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`: TikTok.
  • `PLACEMENT_PANGLE`: Pangle.
  • `PLACEMENT_GLOBAL_APP_BUNDLE`: Global App Bundle.
| ###| identity | string | Identity type that was used for the delivery of the video.

Enum values:
  • `SPARK_ADS`: Spark Ads identities, including Authorized User, TikTok User, and TikTok Account User in Business Center identities.
  • `NON_SPARK_ADS`: Non-Spark Ads identities, that is, Custom User identities.

To learn more about identity types, see [Identities](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1738958351620097). | ###| currency | string | The code of the currency in which the metric data in `metrics` is calculated.

Example: USD.

To learn about the currency that a currency code corresponds to, see [Budget verification ratio and precision of each currency](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737585839634433). | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "list": [ { "metrics": { "impressions": "63727", "cpm": "10.27", "ctr": "0.38", "organic_video_views": null, "clicks": "243", "cpc": "2.69", "spend": "654.39", "conversion_rate_v2": "0.01", "conversion": "6", "cost_per_conversion": "109.07" }, "info": { "material_name": "{{material_name}}", "identity": "NON_SPARK_ADS", "placement": [ "PLACEMENT_TIKTOK" ], "video_material_source": "UPLOADED_TO_TIKTOK_ADS_MANAGER", "currency": "USD", "country_code": [ "CA", "US" ], "create_time": "2024-01-11T07:42:46Z", "material_id": "{{material_id}}" } }, { "metrics": { "impressions": "200626", "cpm": "4.62", "ctr": "1.36", "organic_video_views": "58242.0", "clicks": "2732", "cpc": "0.34", "spend": "927.25", "conversion_rate_v2": "0.01", "conversion": "17", "cost_per_conversion": "54.54" }, "info": { "material_name": "{{material_name}}", "tiktok_item_ids": [ "{{tiktok_item_id}}" ], "identity": "SPARK_ADS", "placement": [ "PLACEMENT_TIKTOK" ], "video_material_source": null, "currency": "USD", "country_code": [ "CA", "US" ], "create_time": "2023-09-25T08:47:43Z", "material_id": "{{material_id}}" } } ], "page_info": { "total_number": 2, "total_page": 1, "page_size": 10, "page": 1 } } } (/code) ```
